robot = s.env.robots[0]

dadr = np.array([m.joint(f"robot0_joint{i}").dofadr[0] for i in range(1, 8)])
qlo = np.array([m.jnt_range[m.joint(f"robot0_joint{i}").id, 0] + 0.002 for i in range(1, 8)])
qhi = np.array([m.jnt_range[m.joint(f"robot0_joint{i}").id, 1] - 0.002 for i in range(1, 8)])
base_id = m.body("mobilebase0_base").id
meat_id = m.body("meat_main").id
board_id = m.body("receptacle_main").id


def command(q=None, grip=1.0, base=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), torso=0.0, mode=-1.0):
    a = np.zeros(13, dtype=np.float64)
    a[:7] = d.qpos[qadr] if q is None else q
    a[7] = grip
    a[8:11] = base
    a[11] = torso
    a[12] = mode
    return a


def solve_ik(target, q0=None, Rgoal=None):
    """Damped least-squares site IK, used only to calculate joint action targets."""
    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
    q0 = d.qpos[qadr].copy() if q0 is None else np.asarray(q0, dtype=float).copy()
    if Rgoal is None:
        Rgoal = d.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3).copy()
    else:
        Rgoal = np.asarray(Rgoal, dtype=float).reshape(3, 3).copy()
    saved = np.empty(mujoco.mj_stateSize(m, casa_tool.STATE_SPEC))
    mujoco.mj_getState(m, d, saved, casa_tool.STATE_SPEC)
    q = q0.copy()
    for _ in range(260):
        d.qpos[qadr] = q
        mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
        p = d.site_xpos[site].copy()
        R = d.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3).copy()
        ep = target - p
        er = Rotation.from_matrix(Rgoal @ R.T).as_rotvec()
        jp = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
        jr = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
        mujoco.mj_jacSite(m, d, jp, jr, site)
        J = np.vstack((jp[:, dadr], 0.30 * jr[:, dadr]))
        e = np.r_[ep, 0.30 * er]
        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.0015 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.025:
            break
        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + 1e-4 * np.eye(6), e)
        null = np.eye(7) - np.linalg.pinv(J) @ J
        dq += 0.018 * null @ (q0 - q)
        mag = np.max(np.abs(dq))
        if mag > 0.14:
            dq *= 0.14 / mag

    mujoco.mj_forward(m, d)
    mujoco.mj_setState(m, d, saved, casa_tool.STATE_SPEC)
    if np.linalg.norm(ep) > 0.035 or np.linalg.norm(er) > 0.20:
